_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to <APP_DIR>/config/credentials.json on each box, chmod 600, fill in real secrets. NEVER commit the real file (it is gitignored). Keys/structure taken from the code (cirrus_bot.py, cirrus_daily.py, intake.py, cirrus_api.py). A blank/missing model or api_key simply disables that tier — no error.
_comment_env: For CUMULUS use the BETA identity: a separate Telegram bot, a separate test inbox/sender, and its own api_token — so beta never contaminates prod. See docs/CUMULUS-Tuesday-Bringup-Runbook.md.
api_token: REPLACE — admin API token (sent as X-API-Token / ?token=). Generate fresh per box; do NOT reuse CIRRUS's.
anthropic_api_key: REPLACE — Claude API key (dev-agent brain + optional premium summary tier)
claude_dev_model: REPLACE-OR-BLANK — heavier Claude model for the dev-agent (leave blank to reuse claude_model)
gemini_api_key: REPLACE-OR-BLANK — enables the Gemini fallback tier
grok_api_key: REPLACE-OR-BLANK — enables the Grok fallback tier
_comment_panel: Research-engine LLM panel (Session 41). NEW providers — need their own accounts + API keys. Use SEPARATE beta keys on CUMULUS (isolate cost/usage from prod; rotate independently if leaked). All are OpenAI-compatible chat endpoints, so call_openai/call_deepseek mirror call_grok.
openai_api_key: REPLACE-OR-BLANK — OpenAI account key (adds GPT to the panel)
deepseek_api_key: REPLACE-OR-BLANK — DeepSeek account key (adds DeepSeek to the panel)
_comment_dev_escalation: Self-improvement builder (dev_agent via llm_providers.py, S44). claude_dev_model above is the primary builder brain. To let the builder use OTHER linked models, add their keys/models above and set the policy below. mode: single (first available in order) | failover (try order until one succeeds) | council (query all available, compare/vote). Providers with no key are skipped. Leave as-is (anthropic-only) to keep today's behavior.
_comment_llm_budget: Spend guard (llm_budget.py, S46). Escalation is INERT until llm_escalation_enabled=true AND anthropic_api_key is set. Caps are per-BOX, USD; each machine (MacBook/CIRRUS/CUMULUS) keeps its own ledger at out/llm-spend-ledger.jsonl. Fail-closed: unpriced model / unreadable ledger => blocked. Set box to identify this machine in the ledger + Telegram alerts. Kill switch: flip llm_escalation_enabled=false (no deploy needed).
_comment_telegram: BETA bot on CUMULUS — create a new bot via @BotFather (e.g. @cumulus_beta_bot) so beta alerts are distinct from the prod CIRRUS bot. telegram_user_id is your own numeric Telegram id (unchanged).
telegram_user_id: REPLACE — your numeric Telegram user id
_comment_sender: outlook_* keys are MISNAMED in the code — they are actually the Gmail SMTP sender (smtp.gmail.com:587) used for acks/sends. On CUMULUS beta use a SEPARATE test sender so beta mail never mixes with prod client sends. Use a Gmail App Password, not the account password.
outlook_password: REPLACE — Gmail App Password for the beta sender
_comment_mail_from_name: Email From DISPLAY NAME on all outbound mail (client sends, acks, digest, bid emails). Per box so mail reads as coming from the machine that sent it. Code defaults to 'CIRRUS' if unset; set 'CUMULUS' on the beta box. Optionally add a company suffix, e.g. 'CIRRUS — Knight Property Services'.
_comment_accounts: Inbound mailboxes scanned by intake.py. Each account's password is stored under the top-level key named by its credential_key (see acct_pw_beta below). On beta, point at a test inbox, not the prod research inbox.
acct_pw_beta: REPLACE — Gmail App Password for the beta inbox (referenced by accounts[].credential_key)
_comment_optional: Below are OPTIONAL — only needed if the matching job runs on this box. Not read by the core digest.
brave_api_key: OPTIONAL — Brave Search API key, only if HOA/lead enrichment (kent_enrich) runs here
github_token: OPTIONAL — PAT for git pull/deploy if not using an SSH deploy key
